targetText: "The change in a historical epoch can always be determined by women's progress towards freedom, because here, in the relation of woman to man, of the weak to the strong, the victory of human nature over brutality is most evident. The degree of emancipation of woman is the natural measure of general emancipation."
explanation: Quoting Charles Fourier to establish a cornerstone of Marxist feminism: the degree of female emancipation is the natural measure of general social freedom.
